title: Exploring binding mode assessment of novel kaempferol, resveratrol, and quercetin derivatives with PPAR-alpha as potent drug candidates against cancer.
authors: Ballav, Sangeeta; Lokhande, Kiran Bharat; Yadav, Rohit Singh; Ghosh, Payel; Swamy, K V; Basu, Soumya
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究天然化合物衍生物与PPAR-alpha转录因子的结合，虽涉及TF-配体互作，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPAR)-alpha, a ligand-activated transcription factor stands out to be a valuable protein target against cancer. Given that ligand binding is the crucial process for the activation of PPAR-alpha, fibrate class of synthetic compounds serves as potent agonist for the receptor. However, their serious side effects limit the long-term application in cancer. This emphasizes the dire need to identify new candidates that would exert desired activation by abrogating the adverse effects caused by synthetic agonists. Natural dietary products serve as an important source of drug discovery. Hence, the present study encompasses the investigation of the role of natural plant phenolic compounds: kaempferol, resveratrol, and quercetin and their 8708 derivatives by the means of computational pipeline comprising molecular docking and molecular dynamic (MD) simulation techniques. Docking calculations shortlisted potential candidates, namely 6-cinnamylchrysin (6-CC), resveratrol potassium-4-sulfate (RPS) and 6-[2-(3,4-Dihydroxyphenyl)-5-hydroxy-4-oxochromen-7-yl]oxyhexyl nitrate (DHOON), and derivatives of kaempferol, resveratrol, and quercetin, respectively. 6-CC, RPS, and DHOON manifested better affinities of - 32.83 kcal/mol (Ala333, Lys358, His440), - 27.22 kcal/mol (Tyr314, Met355), and - 30.18 kcal/mol (Ser280, Tyr314, Ala333), respectively, and were found to act as good stimulants for PPAR-alpha. Among these three compounds, 6-CC caused relatively least deviations and fluctuations analyzed through MD simulation which judiciously held responsible to attain most favorable interaction with PPAR-alpha. Followed by the binding free energy (DeltaG) calculations using MM-GBSA confirmed the key role of 6-CC toward PPAR-alpha. The compound 6-CC also achieved high drug-likeness and pharmacokinetic properties. Thus, these findings stipulate new drug leads for PPAR-alpha receptor which abets a way to develop new anti-cancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPAR）-alpha，一种配体激活的转录因子，是抗癌治疗中一个重要的蛋白质靶点。鉴于配体结合是激活PPAR-alpha的关键过程，贝特类合成化合物作为该受体的强效激动剂。然而，它们的严重副作用限制了其在癌症中的长期应用。这强调了迫切需要识别新的候选物，这些候选物能够通过消除合成激动剂引起的不良反应来实现所需的激活。天然膳食产品是药物发现的重要来源。因此，本研究通过包含分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟技术的计算流程，探讨了天然植物酚类化合物：山奈酚、白藜芦醇和槲皮素及其8708种衍生物的作用。对接计算筛选出潜在候选物，分别为6-肉桂基白杨素（6-CC）、白藜芦醇钾-4-硫酸盐（RPS）和6-[2-(3,4-二羟基苯基)-5-羟基-4-氧代色烯-7-基]氧基己基硝酸酯（DHOON），这些分别是山奈酚、白藜芦醇和槲皮素的衍生物。6-CC、RPS和DHOON表现出更好的亲和力，分别为-32.83 kcal/mol（Ala333、Lys358、His440）、-27.22 kcal/mol（Tyr314、Met355）和-30.18 kcal/mol（Ser280、Tyr314、Ala333），并被发现是PPAR-alpha的良好刺激剂。在这三种化合物中，通过MD模拟分析，6-CC引起的偏差和波动相对最小，这合理地归因于其与PPAR-alpha形成了最有利的相互作用。随后使用MM-GBSA进行的结合自由能（DeltaG）计算确认了6-CC对PPAR-alpha的关键作用。化合物6-CC还实现了高药物相似性和药代动力学特性。因此，这些发现为PPAR-alpha受体提供了新的药物先导物，有助于开发新的抗癌药物。
